test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Hardly had the meeting started (1)/ when several members (2)/ begin raising objections (3)/ to the proposal. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**begin**" is incorrect in the context of the sentence as it is in the present tense.
 
• Since the sentence uses "**Hardly had the meeting started**," which indicates past perfect tense, the verb in the following clause should be in the past tense as well.
 
• The correct verb is "**began**" to maintain tense consistency.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Hardly had the meeting started when several members **began** raising objections to the proposal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "Hardly had the meeting started"** – This part is correct as it uses the past perfect tense appropriately.
 
• **Part 2: "when several members"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "to the proposal"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
